purpose: use only the already retained responses to determine whether the four eleven-row sample shortfalls also fail the unchanged economic role gates; the adjudication may strengthen rejection but can never repair the consumed minimum-row gate or promote a candidate

method.orientation: reuse each frozen prefilter orientation without refit
method.cash_flows: reuse exact retained Polymarket hourly and Binance Regular plus Special funding rows
method.costs: reuse the 20-bip round-trip execution hurdle and 500-bip annual opportunity hurdle on each of two capital legs
method.role_split: apply the unchanged deterministic splitter to the actual retained aligned count; eleven rows become five training three validation and three test

decision.all_symbols_fail_economic_role_gate: terminalize the exact family before books and do not repeat absent a material funding fee session or instrument change
decision.any_symbol_passes_economic_role_gate: preserve only as a sample-shortfall lead; wait for a prospectively distinct complete window and request no books
